text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] pref ill_gpu_oom spike detected on cluster eu-1. Multiple container restarts observed. Pager: @tanya.

tanya: Oncall here, joining bridge — what systems are showing customer impact?

ashley: Hosted API: increased 5xx for generate and stream routes. Root cause appears to be prefill OOMs for long-context requests (>24k tokens) hitting vicuna-13b-q4 on eu-1. Containers restarting on node-23.

sam: Investigating logs now, seeing repeated CUDA resets + OOM kills. Snippet:```NVRM: Xid (0x20) 13 0x00000000 0x00000000 0x00000000```

tanya: Can we short-term route long-context requests elsewhere or fallback to a smaller model?

ashley: Rolling a routing change now: route requests with context >16k to vicuna-13b-q4-small and enable aggressive kvcache eviction policy on eu-1. Applying config.

incident-bot: Runbook action applied: throttle_prefill_max_context=16000 on fleet eu-1. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-oom for checklist.

sam: Doing live eviction on node-23 and restarting affected containers (graceful). ETA ~7m. Will monitor container_restart_rate.

margo: CS: Customers X and Y reported streaming cuts and truncated outputs ~10:12Z. Sent holding update: "We are mitigating GPU OOMs; long-context requests may be shortened temporarily. Expect partial service restoration within 15-30 minutes."

tanya: Handing off in 30m to @ashley for night rotation. Leaving bridge but will watch signal channels.

ashley: Adding temp alerts for pref ill_oom_rate and container_restart_rate; creating a follow-up postmortem ticket.

sam: Additional logs: ```containerd: exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
nvidia-smi: GPU0 Memory Usage 31.9/32 GiB```

incident-bot: Incident updated — severity: high; customer-impact: confirmed; runbook-id: rb-204.

margo: :thumbsup: will push a customer advisory once we see stable metrics for 10m.
